subject: EdgeWave onramp — request for combined credit bundle + short-term discount (exec sign-off needed)
messages:
From: Timothy Park <timothy.park@edgewave.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: procure@edgewave.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — combined credits + short discount for onramp pilot

Diego —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our engineers ran a deeper integration test over the weekend and we need a little more runway to finish the connector verification and latency benchmarking. Two asks from our side: 

1) A 45–60 day trial extension with an additional credits bucket (we estimate ~$8k of incremental usage while we complete evaluation).
2) A one-time promotional discount of 20% on the first three months post-onboarding (we want to accelerate an initial committed purchase).

If Redwood can bundle the credits + discount the procurement team will be able to move to an expedited PO and a proposed 12‑month commitment. I attached our initial SOW for context.

Can you let me know what flexibility you have here and whether this needs exec sign-off?

–Timothy

[Attachment: EdgeWave_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 128KB)]

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Timothy Park <timothy.park@edgewave.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request — combined credits + short discount for onramp pilot

Timothy —

Appreciate the quick context and the SOW. We can absolutely structure a combined package but to get the economics to work we typically pair credits with a short-term promotional rate tied to a commitment. My proposed path: 

- 60 day extension to the trial window
- $10,000 usage credit applied to the trial account (consumable during the 60 days)
- 25% promotional discount on invoice for the first 3 months after conversion, contingent on a 12‑month committed contract

This is slightly ahead of our standard delegated authority so I need to escalate for executive sign-off for the 25% slice. I attached an internal pricing memo and a draft SOW that folds the credits into the onramp.

If that package looks acceptable I will request approval now and loop in Legal/PO to get a DocuSign. Can you confirm procurement timelines if we get sign-off today?

Thanks —
Diego
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: pricing-memo-internal.xlsx; Attachment: EdgeWave_SOW_v2_revised.pdf]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: EdgeWave onramp — request for combined credit bundle + short-term discount (exec sign-off needed)

Markus —

Forwarding an inbound ask from EdgeWave (deal EW-2027-071). Quick summary: they need a 60-day extension + $10k trial credit and are requesting 25% off the first three months if they sign a 12‑month commitment. Diego is recommending we approve the package to secure conversion momentum — estimated first-year ARR impact ~$95k at midline.

Key considerations: 
- Credit spend will largely be used during integration testing (low production risk).
- The promotional discount is time-boxed (first 3 months only) and conditioned on a 12‑month deal.
- Procurement is standing by; if we approve today we get PO in 48–72h.

Asking for your sign-off or counter. If you'd rather reduce promo to 20% we can close faster, but it may add friction with procurement (they are pushing for the 25%).

Cheers,
Marissa
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeWave onramp — request for combined credit bundle + short-term discount (exec sign-off needed)

Marissa / Diego —

Approve the package with these conditions: 

1) Approve 20% promotional discount on first three months (reduced from 25%) but keep the $10k trial credit and 60‑day extension.
2) Require a signed 12‑month commitment and standard early-termination recoup language in the SOW.
3) Legal to add an explicit depletion window for the credit (credits expire at the end of the 60 days).

Reasoning: preserves conversion incentive while tightening margin impact. If procurement absolutely needs 25% we can approve on a case-by-case basis with a CRO-level memo and additional commercial concessions (e.g., deferred billing).

Markus
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
